finding_key: packages/backend/src/document/document.controller.ts::the changed `attachmeta` / list-ordering behavior (the point of the pr) is untested
evidence: Verified against the supplied files: packages/backend/src/document/document.controller.spec.ts contains only the three `createDocument` fileId-gating cases and constructs the controller with a `{ getSummaries: jest.fn() }` Yorkie stub — it never invokes `findByWorkspace`/`getDocuments`, so the rewritten `attachMeta` (document.controller.ts:53-70) and the new `orderBy: [{updatedAt:'desc'},{createdAt:'desc'}]` (lines ~116, ~148) are never exercised. The e2e suite (test/authenticated-http.e2e-spec.ts, the `enforces document ownership` case) lists documents but asserts only `toHaveLength(1)` and `body[0].id`, and stubs YorkieAdminService with empty maps, so neither the `updatedAt` source nor the ordering is asserted anywhere; the new unit specs added by the PR cover the guard, key parser, webhook controller and `updateDocument`, not the read path. Real test-adequacy gap on the PR's central behavior, though it is a missing-coverage issue rather than a production defect.
